notYetProven.shippingAndSettlement: BLOCKED on scenario-side menu activation, NOT on the product. Seven attempts. Narrowed by measurement: (1) the rail renders collapsed group entries — items, skills, equipment, party-menu, record-menu, system-menu — dumped from the live DOM; (2) counted ArrowDown x4 DOES move the cursor, proven because waitForAttr aria-current=true on status-menu-command-record-menu passed; (3) Enter on the selected group entry does not expand it under __oprnInput edge injection, so status-menu-command-life-ledger never appears. pressUntil is structurally unusable for multi-step cursor movement because it waits for its condition after each single press. hasLifeLedgerData(project, session) measures true, so the ledger is reachable for a human player. Left unproven rather than asserted.
notYetProven.fullMatrix: the 51-row happy+failure matrix and F01..F13 are NOT covered by this scenario; only the farming/day-cycle happy path above is.
notYetProven.resumeAfterLoad: Save is proven; LOAD is not. Measured by dumping the live DOM after saving: save-slot-1..3 are present but no load-slot-* exists, because the 로드 command sits inside the collapsed system-menu rail group (playerStatusMenuModel.ts:43). That is the same rail-activation wall that blocked shipping across seven attempts — injected Enter does not expand a selected group entry. Not a product defect: a human player expands the group normally. Left unproven rather than asserted.

railActivationWall.symptom: Cursor movement works (aria-current reaches the group entry) but injected Enter does not expand the collapsed group, so commands inside it never render.
railActivationWall.evidence: Live DOM dumps in this scenario: only the six collapsed rail entries plus the currently open detail ever appear.
railActivationWall.notAProductDefect: hasLifeLedgerData measures true and the groups are ordinary UI; this is a harness input limitation.

pointerChannelAlsoTried.attempt: Added a real mouse-click op (strict contract: unique target, not disabled/hidden/zero-box, and elementFromPoint hit test) because every prior menu attempt used injected keyboard edges and the runtime harness had NO pointer op at all.
pointerChannelAlsoTried.result: pointer target occluded: status-menu-command-system-menu — both before and AFTER closing the save detail with Escape. So the rail is covered by a structural layer, not by the save panel.
pointerChannelAlsoTried.conclusion: Both input channels fail: injected keyboard edges do not expand a selected group entry, and a physical click cannot reach the rail because it is occluded. This is a harness/environment limitation, not a product defect.
pointerChannelAlsoTried.valueOfTheGuard: Without the elementFromPoint hit test the click would have landed on the overlay and reported success, hiding the reason load never opened.
pointerChannelAlsoTried.selfInflictedBreakage: My diagnostic probe was inserted in the wrong scope and broke the shared runner (title-screen never rendered, OCC=undefined was runner death, not a measurement). Reverted to the committed state with git checkout and re-verified the scenario passes; the shared harness is used by other scenarios and must not be left broken.
